fixture.scope: Retained staging feed copy, 179 active revisions, three selected reader stories, complete catalog preserved; locally read-only

limitations: No concurrent D1/provider test during final measurement
Windows CPU granularity is coarse; not Cloudflare CPU
SQLite execution timing includes row extraction, not database server CPU or network wait
Serialized row bytes are measured JSON row-array bytes, not exact D1 HTTP envelope bytes
Warmup excluded, nearest-rank descriptive p50/p95 only
Full-pipeline, inference and canonical-turn improvement unmeasured
Initial projection-only full-input measurements were mixed; selected-only preload is included in final result
No candidate pruning, prompts or paid identities changed by the input optimization

bindingCallSupplement.purpose: Separate SQL statement counts from binding requests; batch statements count once at the binding boundary. Not remote network timings. All sample fingerprints match primary.
